requirements_summary: SaaS support platform building customer-knowledge RAG for helpdesk articles and conversations. Plan: embeddings + ANN store + LLM rerank for top-k answers. Key goals: sub-250ms end-to-end p95 for retrieve+rerank at high QPS, cost-per-query <= $0.002, soft requirement for US-only data residency and SSO/SAML integration.
poc_milestones: Week 0: sample dataset ingest (200-300k articles, transcripts)
Week 1: measure embedding latency and index build time; validate vector store integration
Week 2: sustained 500 QPS load test (simulate production traffic), measure p50/p95 end-to-end
Week 3: cost analysis + rerank model A/B (small vs medium), provide ops runbook
Week 4: security sign-off and decision to scale or pause
notes:
- Customer: multi-tenant SaaS (support ticketing), currently using keyword search + hybrid heuristics.
- Wants to replace with semantic search + LLM reranking to cut resolution time.
- "Latency under 200ms is a must-have for live agent assist" — quote from VP Eng on 2024-12-05 call.
- Interested in Redwood hosted API to avoid infra ops. Cost sensitivity: wants detailed cost model at 500/1k QPS.
- SE asked for sample index (~2M docs) and expected growth to 10M over 12 months.
- Legal: DPA + data residency clause required before production.
- Ops: needs token-level cost breakdown and per-route dashboards for rerank traffic.
- POC ask: include KV/prefix caching test, batch sizing guidance, and quantization recommendations for rerank to meet p95 SLO.
- Quote from support lead: "Must keep false positives low — precision > 85% for top-3"
indexing_scale_estimate: ~2 million docs (~120M tokens) initial; plan to grow to 8-10M over 12 months
qps_target: 500-800 sustained QPS; spikes up to 1,000 QPS during peak
latency_slo: end-to-end p95 <250ms for retrieve + top-5 rerank; p50 <120ms
routing_requirements: primary region us-east, active failover to us-west; intelligent routing by latency and cost tier. Fallback behavior: cached answer or smaller rerank model for budget mode.
additional_context: Architectures under consideration: vector store + model-side rerank vs hybrid ANN + candidate scoring. Team leans toward hosted inference to avoid managing GPU fleet. Strong interest in Redwood Optimize recommendations for batching and quantization.
sales_pitch_notes: Emphasize: predictable latency, transparent per-route cost, ability to run hosted + dedicated later. Offer a concrete POC with 2M-doc index performance metrics and cost delta scenarios.
commercial_notes: Initial ARR target: $50k-$150k. Procurement window: Q1 2025. Legal wants sample DPA + SOC2 artifacts before committing.
